description_en: Invokes DescribeLayer4Rules to query the detailed configurations of port forwarding rules for an Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance
description_zh: 调用DescribeLayer4Rules查询DDoS高防实例端口转发规则的详细配置
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo describe-layer4-rules --source-ip 192.0.XX.XX --instance-id ddoscoo-cn-zvp2ay9b0000 --forward-protocol tcp --frontend-port 233 --offset 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2017-12-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLayer4Rules

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request. You do not need to specify this parameter. The system automatically obtains the value
parameters.help_zh: 请求源ip。无需填写，系统自动获取
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance to query.

You can invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91478.html to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的DDoS高防实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91478.html查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The forwarding protocol type. Valid values:
tcp: TCP protocol.
udp: UDP protocol
parameters.help_zh:
转发协议类型。取值：
tcp：表示TCP协议。
udp：表示UDP协议
parameters.name: forward_protocol

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return in a paged query. The minimum value is 1, which indicates the first page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。最小值为1，表示返回第1页数据
parameters.name: offset

parameters.help_en: The number of results per page in a paged query. The maximum value is 50, which indicates that each page contains up to 50 results
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页包含结果的数量。最大值为50，表示每页最多包含50个结果
parameters.name: page_size
